proposals.text:
Thanks — I can proceed, but I don’t have a way to look up an account by phone number with the tools available to me here. Per our lookup options, I can search the account by one of these:

- Full name (case-sensitive as on the account)
- Rho‑Bank user ID
- Email address on file

If you can provide one of those now I’ll verify the two fields you already gave (DOB 11/03/1990 and phone 312-555-0481) and continue the investigation. If you’d rather not provide any of those here, you can:

- Call 1-800-RHO-BANK or
- Use secure chat in the Rho‑Bank mobile app (where you can be looked up by phone)

Which would you like to do? If you want to proceed here, please give either your exact full name as on file, your user ID, or your email address.
